items.title: Why has De Bruyne struggled at Napoli as he returns to Man City?
items.summary: Kevin de Bruyne's move to Napoli last summer was supposed to mark a continuation of his glittering decade at Manchester City as he approaches the twilight years of his career.

items.title: Defender Heaven open to leaving Man Utd
items.summary: Manchester United defender Ayden Heaven is open to a loan move in January amid concerns over his game time as his side battles in the Premier League relegation zone.

items.title: One of football's most-hyped 16-year-olds - what next for JJ Gabriel?
items.summary: BBC Sport looks at why JJ Gabriel's move from Manchester United to Real Madrid has caused such a stir.

items.title: MNC: Leeds dreaming of Europe and when's the right time to start a young player?
items.summary: Mark Chapman is joined by Conor Coady, Chris Sutton and Rory Smith.

items.title: Were any current Man City players signed during charges period?
items.summary: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team looks at whether any Manchester City players were signed during the time the club have been found guilty of breaching the Premier League's financial rules.

items.title: Arsenal had more than 20 players on shortlist to capitalise on title win
items.summary: Senior football correspondent Sami Mokbel goes inside Arsenal's bid to capitalise on their Premier League title and strengthen their squad this summer.

items.title: Berrada admits Man Utd transfer spending will be limited by stadium plans
items.summary: Manchester United chief executive Omar Berrada admits plans to build a new 100,000-seater stadium will limit transfer spending in upcoming windows.
